notes: The PDF has no inventory pages, so no Element IDs are printed. Part types were matched by eye to the catalogue, with colours as props. Treat the matches as approximate.

Ball-hitch plate b3 was mapped to lego-6039479, but the booklet shows a light grey 2x2 plate with a ball. The brush holder, bristle roller, hose, nozzle base and pipe holder were not in the catalogue, so they are new types.
Step 3 of the brush sub-assembly (page 9) has a red arrow at the roller end. It was read as pushing the roller fully into the holder, with no extra part.
Parts are numbered b1-b62 in build order. Main chassis is b1-b34, brush b35-b36, minifig b37-b40, cab top b41, roof b42-b49, then broom, pipe holder, tank, rear light, nozzle and arm.

Single-use port conflicts were resolved by leaving the port null on the extra edges. Catalogue entries such as the 2x8 plate b1 list only one stud and one anti-stud port, but several parts sit on them.

The roof joins the black holder b41 by anti-studs onto studs. The hose uses ball ends. The pipe holder has a bar for the clip on b29 and a socket for the hose. The nozzle has an axle stub, and the grey arm is mapped to the clip-end connector lego-6271540, which clips onto handle bar b12.

Steering wheel b27 is lego-3829. Minifig legs b37 are mapped to the blue catalogue legs lego-6031019, because lego-9341 and lego-970c00 were not accepted as real part numbers. The legs only rest on the ball plate b3 (contact), as the booklet shows no stud connection.
Wheel holders sit under the base plate b1. Each has two pins, so four wheels in total. The wheels are one per pin, not a repeated sub-assembly.
The tank pin b54 goes into the grey Technic brick b25 hole, as in step 14. The roof clip details are approximate. The clip plate b57 grips the roof handle plate b45 (step 15).
